Cells with a clean own-grid baseline (axis-1 scaffolds, belief scaffolds, loss-aversion frames) keep it; all others --- including the axis-2 treatments Payoff Safety and Payoff Tree --- are tested against the corrected pooled baseline (legacy pooled-of-three and dedicated-SPSB comparisons are in the CSV, clearly labeled). $p$-values are wild-cluster bootstrap (Rademacher weights, 2000 reps, seed 1299), clustered by run directory; each sealed cell is one cluster per model, so contrasts have $8$--$16$ clusters and naive cluster-robust SEs are unreliable; a cluster-permutation cross-check and the naive $p$ are in the CSV. Target-language increases for levers whose prompt seeds the target vocabulary (worst-case, dominated, belief, clock-framing, risk/loss cells) are partly prompt echo; the menu cell's rule-rehearsal target is $0$ by construction because its prompt removes the second-price vocabulary (caveat 6b). \texttt{results/traces/mediation/manipulation\_checks.csv}.}
